Class UserSession

java.lang.Object
domain.UserSession
public class UserSession extends Object
Manages the session for users within the system, providing functionality for login, logout, and session persistence using the singleton pattern. This class ensures that only one instance of UserSession exists during the application's lifecycle.

  • Method Details

    • getInstance

      public static UserSession getInstance()
      Retrieves the single instance of the UserSession class. This method ensures that only one instance of the UserSession class exists throughout the application's lifecycle, following the singleton pattern. If no instance exists, a new one is created and returned.
      Returns:
      The single instance of the UserSession class.

    • getUser

      public User getUser()
      Retrieves the current user associated with the session. This method fetches the user stored with the key "currentUser" in the internal user map of the session. If no user is associated with the session, this method may return null.
      Returns:
      The current User object associated with the session, or null if no user is set.

    • setUser

      public void setUser(User usr)
      Updates the current user in the session. This method associates the specified User instance with the key "currentUser" in the session. Any previously set user will be replaced with the new user. The User instance provided must not be null.
      Parameters:
      usr - The User object to be set as the current user in the session. Must not be null.

    • doLogin

      public boolean doLogin(User usr)
      Logs in the specified user by updating the current session with the provided user instance. This method sets the provided User object as the current user in the session using the setUser method. The user must be a valid, non-null User instance. Upon successful login, this method returns true.
      Parameters:
      usr - The User object to be logged in. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      true if the user was successfully logged in.

    • clear

      public void clear()
      Clears all entries in the internal user session data structure. This method removes all user mappings in the session, effectively resetting the session's state to an empty state. It is typically used to log out all users or to reset the session data entirely.

    • doLogout

      public boolean doLogout()
      Logs the current user out of the session by clearing all session data. This method invokes the clear method to reset the session's internal data structure, effectively logging out the currently active user. Once the session is cleared, this method returns true to indicate a successful logout operation.
      Returns:
      true if the logout operation was successful.
